basic_info.description: Unbeatable Value near Alamo Square! Located at the vibrant crossroads of Hayes Valley, NOPA, and Alamo Square, this peaceful and exceptionally quiet garden-level 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home is tucked away at the back of the building on Oak Street, offering a serene retreat in the heart of the city. Enjoy modern, meticulously updated living with one-car parking, your own washer/dryer, private entrance, backyard, storage, and more! This home boasts a stylish open floor plan with an eat-in kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, designer cabinetry, and wide-plank flooring. Spacious bedrooms include custom closet organizers, and the two full bathrooms are elegantly appointed. The unit also has a dedicated laundry room for added convenience. Located at the rear of a four-unit building - and with its own entrance - this unit is quiet and serene and offers easy access to the shared, neat and lush garden. Ideally located just minutes from Hayes Valley's shops, restaurants, and bars, as well as iconic Alamo Square and Golden Gate Park. Commuters will appreciate easy access to the 101 freeway and nearby MUNI/BART stations. With a 99 Walk Score and 90 Transit Score, this home is truly a must-see!
